quest.title: Just Like Old Times
quest.description: Go to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests...

talks.objective: Head to a high vantage point in the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Well, this is one for the books. Never thought I'd see the day when you'd invite me to one of your tea parties, Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Perhaps if you'd worked on your etiquette, I would have invited you over sooner.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: I agree. It might also help your case if you stopped challenging people to duels all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Heh. You sound exactly like my big brothers and sisters. I can't help it. Back when my master was training me in the wild, etiquette wasn't exactly a priority.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Forget it. It's not often we manage to get together. Let's just relax and enjoy the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hmm. Is this your latest creation?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Her name is Fagio. It stands for "Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache."

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Does this mean Pulonia is really beyond repair...? I'm sorry to hear that, Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It's fine, I...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry to hear that I'll never get the chance to fight him.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Of course you are...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Pulonia looked strong, but this "Fagio" on the other hand...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...Were you about to say she looks weak?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Uhm... Haha, no, no. It's just that she doesn't look quite as strong as Pulonia.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph. Pulonia was built for measurements and calculations. I was careful not to compromise his processing power when giving him combat capabilities.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: But Fagio doesn't need to process complex formulas. All of her computing power can be devoted to her combat module.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: So... That means she's actually stronger than Pulonia? Is that even possible...?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You really won't be satisfied without a demonstration, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Just so we're clear, I'm not paying for any repairs if I break her.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: And I won't be paying your hospital bill.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: (*sigh*... I knew this would happen.)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: (*nom nom*...)

talks.objective: Head to a high vantage point in the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Not bad, these tea parties, all in all. If I'd known they were this much fun, I would've attended one sooner.

choices.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.
